verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax's docs show a real-time Tax Calculations API that determines rates from full customer address, ship-from address, and even IP geolocation, well beyond ZIP-code approximation (stripe-tax-docs-2, -4, -5, -15, -16), and a community user confirms it 'does all of that automatically, based on the customer full address' (stripe-tax-comm-1). However, independent community reports claim the international coverage is 'woefully incomplete' and that Stripe Tax is 'vastly outgunned by competitors' like Avalara (stripe-tax-comm-11, -12), casting doubt on completeness/accuracy at scale, and no latency/performance benchmarks are provided to confirm checkout-speed suitability. Missing for 10: independent latency benchmarks proving checkout-speed performance, explicit 'rooftop-level' accuracy validation, and resolution of the international-coverage complaints.
